title: Assessing Elevated Blood Glucose Levels Through Blood Glucose Evaluation and Monitoring Using Machine Learning and Wearable Photoplethysmography Sensors: Algorithm Development and Validation.
summary: Machine-learning models combined wearable photoplethysmography and glucose-monitoring data to assess elevated blood glucose, with performance evaluated against reference glucose measurements.
ai_technology: A radial-basis-function support-vector machine uses wrist photoplethysmography features and participant data to detect elevated blood glucose against glucometer measurements.
organization: Actxa Pte Ltd; Activate Interactive Pte Ltd

evidence.tested: Among 500 participants, the best model achieved mean accuracy 84.7%, sensitivity 81.05% and specificity 88.3% under 10-fold cross-validation.
evidence.unknown: This is a controlled measurement study; clinical screening benefit and performance in unsupervised use are unestablished.
evidence.ai_role: A radial-basis-function support-vector machine uses wrist photoplethysmography features and participant data to detect elevated blood glucose against glucometer measurements.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
